messages.content: my mother and i want to put a plant near the window. i want it on the table, but she needs the table for work.
is there another place near the window where the plant could stand without being in the way of her work?
there is a shelf, but i cannot reach it.
then the shelf may not work if you need to take care of the plant yourself. is there a place you can reach, or could your mother help when you need to reach it?
she said she can help, but i want to do it myself.
then it would be useful to choose a place you can reach. you can explain that taking care of it yourself is part of your goal.
write a short sentence i can say to her.
i want to take care of the plant myself, so can we find a place i can reach?
she thinks we could use a small table near the window.
a small table near the window could leave her work table free and keep the plant where you can reach it.
we have not found that small table yet. should you say the plant is already there?
no. it is a possible plan, not something you have done yet.
what is one thing we need before making that the plan?
you need a small table that works for the place you have chosen.
now we found one. give me the plan as two sentences.
put the small table near the window. keep the plant there so you can reach it without using the work table.
i told my friend i was tired of cleaning my room. she came over and started moving my books. i wanted someone to talk to, not someone to move things.
you can thank her for the help and still make clear what kind of help you wanted. would you like a sentence to say that?
yes. make it kind, but keep the books where they are.
thank you for the help. could we leave the books where they are and just talk for a while?
what if she says talking will not clean the room?
you can say that you know the room still needs cleaning, but you are asking for a short talk before doing more.
write that without saying she is wrong.
i know talking will not clean the room. i just need a short talk before i do more.
can i ask her to stay without asking her to clean?
yes. asking someone to stay and talk is different from asking them to do the cleaning.
now she says she only has a few minutes.
then you can choose a short conversation and keep the rest of the cleaning for later. her having only a few minutes does not mean she does not care.
write a reply about those few minutes without giving her a new task.
a few minutes to talk would be nice. thank you for being here.
make it just a little shorter.
a few minutes to talk would be nice. thank you.
what is the difference between helping me and choosing for me?
help can begin with what you need. choosing for you can change your things or your plan before you have said that is what you want.
there is a container on a shelf with a red ball inside. i take the ball out and put it under the table. then i close the container. where is the ball?
the red ball is under the table.
where is the container?
on the shelf.
does closing it bring the ball back inside?
no. you took the ball out before closing the container. you did not say you put it back.
now my brother moves the closed container to the floor. where is the ball?
still under the table, from what you have told me.
why not on the floor with the container?
because he moved the container after you took the ball out. moving the container does not move a ball that is no longer inside it.
could there be other things inside the container?
yes. i know the red ball was taken out, but you did not say whether there are other things inside the container.
then say why the red ball did not move without calling the container empty.
the red ball was under the table when your brother moved the container. you did not say anyone moved that ball.
now i put the red ball back inside the container. where is it?
it is inside the container on the floor.
can you give me just the place at the end with no story?
inside the container on the floor.
now answer in a full sentence.
the red ball is inside the container on the floor.
if i ask why my sister went to the library, is at the library an answer?
no. at the library gives a place. why asks for a reason.
what question would at the library answer?
where is your sister?
now here is the reason: she needed a quiet place to read. answer my first question.
she went to the library because she needed a quiet place to read.
what if i ask how she got there?
then i would need information about her journey, such as whether she walked or took a train. the reason for going does not give the way she went.
she walked with her friend. give the how answer only.
she walked with her friend.
now make a sentence that gives the way and the reason.
she walked to the library with her friend because she needed a quiet place to read.
what if the friend just walked with her but did not go inside?
that can still be true. walking with her to the library does not have to mean the friend went inside too.
write a question that asks about that part.
did her friend go inside the library with her?
i do not know. give me a short reply that keeps it open.
we know they walked there together, but not whether the friend went inside.
can you use the journey to answer when she got there?
not without more information. walking gives the way she went, not when she got there.
help me write a message saying i liked a meal. i liked the soup, but i did not try the cake.
thank you for the meal. i really liked the soup.
can i say everything was good?
that could sound as if you tried everything. if you did not try the cake, it is more clear to say which part you liked.
what if i want to thank them for the whole visit too?
you can thank them for the visit and say you liked the soup. you do not have to give a feeling about every part of the meal.
just write the message.
thank you for having me over. i enjoyed the visit and really liked the soup.
can i add i would like to try the cake another day?
yes, if that is what you want. you can say: i would like to try the cake another day.
now write that thought without asking for another whole meal.
thank you for having me over. i enjoyed the visit and really liked the soup. i would like to try the cake another day, if there is some left.
what if i just say i did not get to try the cake?
then you are saying what you did not try. that alone does not say whether you want to try it later.
show me the whole message with only the fact that i did not try the cake.
thank you for having me over. i enjoyed the visit and really liked the soup. i did not try the cake this time.
then keep the message about the visit and soup only.
thank you for having me over. i enjoyed the visit and really liked the soup.
if i say can you write a story, should you only answer yes?
usually you want me to write the story, not just say that i can. if you have given enough information, i can begin.
write a short story about a child waiting for a train with her father. the train should come at the end.

a child stood with her father at the station. she watched people walking near them and asked which train would be theirs. her father showed her the ticket and told her where they were going. she held his hand and looked down the line. after a few minutes, they heard a sound from far away. the child looked up, and their train came into the station.
give me just the sentence about the sound.
after a few minutes, they heard a sound from far away.
now give me the whole story with that change.

a child stood with her father at the station. she watched people walking near them and asked which train would be theirs. her father showed her the ticket and told her where they were going. she held his hand and looked down the line. after a few minutes, they heard a sound from far away. the child looked up, and their train came into the station.
if i ask you to change one sentence, should the other sentences stay the same?
yes. if you only ask for one sentence to change, i should keep the other sentences the same.
keep it simple and give me only the last sentence now.
the child looked up, and their train came into the station.
can you answer what happened at the end without writing another story?
yes. the train came into the station.
i have a photo of my father standing by a tree. can you know whether he was happy from that alone?
not from the information you gave. you told me where he was standing, but not how he felt.
he has a smile in the picture.
a smile can be a reason to think he felt happy, but a photo alone does not tell us everything about what someone felt.
say that with has a smile.
he has a smile in the picture, but that alone does not tell us for sure how he felt.
i asked him, and he said he was happy because it was the first day of his holiday.
then you have his own answer about the feeling and the reason. you can say he told you he was happy because his holiday had started.
give me just that answer about the feeling.
he told you he was happy because his holiday had started.
write a sentence about the picture in my voice.
in this photo, my father is standing by a tree on the first day of his holiday.
add how he felt, and make clear he told me.
my father told me he was happy on the first day of his holiday, when this photo was taken.
make it shorter, and keep that he told me.
my father told me he was happy that day.
now just say where he was standing.
he was standing by a tree.
if i say i have not read that book yet, does that mean i will never read it?
no. not yet says you have not read it before now. it leaves open whether you will read it later.
what if i have no plan to read it?
then not yet can still be true, but someone might think you may read it later. you could simply say i have not read it if you do not want that idea.
now use already in an example with the same book.
i have already read that book.
does already say i liked it?
no. it says the reading happened before now, not how you felt about the book.
i read only the first page. can i say i have already read the whole book?
no. reading one page is not the same as finishing the whole book.
write a sentence that is true about my one page.
i have already read the first page.
now use not yet about the rest without making it sound as if i hate it.
i have not read the rest of the book yet.
can both of those sentences be true at the same time?
yes. you can have read the first page without having read the rest.
make a question about whether i want to keep reading.
do you want to keep reading?
not right now. just give a short reply.
okay. you can leave it for now.
you gave me the example she reads at home. does that mean read can only be used with she?
no. that is one example, not the only possible sentence. you can also say i read at home or they read at home.
why is it reads with she but read with they?
for these sentences, use reads with she and read with they. the person or group changes the word you use.
can you show the same change with work?
she works at home. they work at home.
now write one with my father and one with my parents.
my father works at home. my parents work at home.
what about my father and mother together?
my father and mother work at home.
why not works when father is still there?
because the sentence is now about two people together. say my father works, but my father and mother work.
should i only look at the last part of a word to choose work or works?
no. you need to look at who the sentence is about. the people work and they work can mean the same thing even though people and they are different words.
can you give a pair with child and children?
the child works at home. the children work at home.
use play instead for those examples.
the child plays at home. the children play at home.
now only give the question about the children.
do the children play at home?
hello. i have a little free time before work.
hello. would you like a short conversation before you go?
yes, but keep it simple. i just made coffee and opened the window.
that sounds like a simple start to the morning. is it warm outside?
it is cold, but the air feels nice for a minute.
a little cold air can feel nice before the room gets too cold.
say it in fewer words.
a little cold air can feel nice for a short time.
i am not asking what to do with the window. just talk with me.
okay. what do you like about this quiet time before work?
nobody needs anything from me yet. i can just sit with my coffee.
that sounds like a little space in the day that is just yours.
can you answer without asking another question?
yes. you have a few quiet minutes with your coffee before the busy part of the day starts.
now say that as if i were telling someone else.
i have a few quiet minutes with my coffee before the busy part of the day starts.
now i have to go. give me a warm short goodbye.
goodbye. i hope your day goes well.
